singleton_scope.protected_decision: Whether A-share minimal-data burst should continue as a research alpha lane before full-data provider readiness.
applies_to: Any A-share minimal-data burst preregistration that can influence future production or research-continuation decisions.

Any change to universe, tier inclusion, entry-flag eligibility, trigger conjunction, pct_5d threshold, amount-expansion threshold, breakout definition, ranking cap, benchmark, holding period, or cost model after the corrected-basis preflight failure.
does_not_authorize: Provider selection, trial, token, paid access, or sample-row collection.

creation_reason.reason: The corrected-basis frozen preregistration produced zero valid signal events on the frozen steady Tier1 universe. Any useful next A-share burst test requires a new universe or trigger degree of freedom, so the program-level ledger is required before redesign.

budget_policy.spend_rule: A promotion-relevant test is spent when a preregistered hypothesis evaluates any registered pass/fail gate on frozen data, including an event-count / power preflight that prevents outcome-return calculation.
budget_policy.no_silent_rescue_rule: Do not use CSI300 diagnostics, Tier2 rows, relaxed entry flags, alternative breakout logic, threshold changes, or a new universe to rescue the failed corrected-basis preregistration without appending a new planned test to this ledger and creating a reviewed preregistration.

test_spend_log.result_summary: valid_signal_events = 0 versus required >= 30; outcome returns and benchmark excess were not computed because the registered trigger has no valid events.
test_spend_log.allowed_followup: Only ledger-gated redesign with a new reviewed preregistration.

planned_tests.design_summary: Ledger-gated redesign of A-share minimal-data burst from the steady Tier1 watchlist to the frozen full EGS candidate surface, with a frozen EOD momentum + volume expansion + breakout trigger and same-anchor CSI1000 benchmark basis.
review_boundary: Claude review passed for the preregistration slice and commit 1a3e71e recorded it; this planned test is authorized only for pre-outcome event-count / input-integrity preflight.
No outcome return, benchmark excess, provider fetch, EGS rerun, cohort regeneration, production runner change, ship-gate claim, live trade, or order automation is authorized by this ledger append.
The planned preregistration remains research-only and the first executable step is only a pre-outcome event-count / input-integrity preflight.
If the preflight has nonzero sufficient events, benchmark-open input under SR-DATA-003 must be resolved before any outcome / excess calculation.

next_required_actions: Run only the reviewed full-universe redesign pre-outcome event-count / input-integrity preflight as the next executable A-share burst step.
Append any additional proposed redesigned A-share burst test to planned_tests before it runs.
Create a new reviewed preregistration for any changed universe / trigger / threshold / benchmark / holding-period design.
Resolve the benchmark-open input precondition before any nonzero-event outcome / excess calculation.
Keep all outputs research-only until later schema review, Claude review, user approval, and separate confirmation evidence.
